### He Is- Holy
Author: Zondervan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/niv-devotions-for-women/niv-devotions-for-women-week-of-feb-6.html
Passage: Leviticus 19:2
Points:
- God defines Himself as holy, which signifies that He is perfect, set apart, and entirely free from evil.
- Because the Lord is holy, He expects His followers to pattern their lives after His holy nature.
- Achieving holiness is impossible through human effort alone; it requires transformation through Jesus Christ.
- Holiness should be understood as a lifelong process that begins at salvation, continues in daily discipleship, and culminates in heaven.
